requirements.text: The system uses a graphical user interface to display data to the user
The system can be used fully with a keyboard
The system can be used fully with a mouse
The system supports multiple games, and can load additional games from an external source
The system has support for multiple opening positions that can be applied to all the games.
The system shall support two player turn-based gaming.
The system has an artificial intelligence that the player may play against.
The artificial intelligence supports every two player game.
The system has an embedded AI that takes over from a player when asked to do so.
The system has files containing implementation of different artificial intelligences that the system can load.
The system prompts the user about implementing the new AI's
The system supports defining new games without modifying the source code.
The system searches an external source for games on startup and loads them.
All the games end on a pre-defined condition
The system saves the game in a file.
The system loads the game from a file.
The system has an embedded help file that contains basic solutions and hints for problematic situations
The system must implement input validation and sandboxing for all externally loaded game definition files and AI plugin files to prevent malicious code execution.
The system shall implement atomic save operations to ensure that existing saved game files are not corrupted if the application crashes or loses power during the write process.
The system shall calculate the next move within 10 seconds on the minimum specified hardware (450 MHz CPU) for all supported game types.
The next move shall be calculated within 2 seconds on a standard reference machine (e.g., 1.0 GHz CPU, 512MB RAM).
The application shall initialize and be ready for user input within 5 seconds of launch on the minimum supported hardware.

OPEN: The system allows saving and loading games from files, but there is no mention of file integrity or path traversal protection. - The system must validate file paths during save/load operations to prevent directory traversal attacks and verify file integrity to prevent tampering with saved game states.

OPEN: The requirement for loading external AI and game definitions lacks a validation strategy for untrusted code or malformed files. - The system shall validate all externally loaded game definitions and AI plugins against a strict schema and execute them within a restricted sandbox to prevent system instability or malicious execution.

OPEN: The requirement for game termination lacks a definition for handling unexpected state errors or invalid game logic. - The system shall implement a robust error handling mechanism that gracefully terminates or resets a game session if an invalid state or logic error is detected, preventing application-wide crashes.

OPEN: There is no specification regarding the maximum number of concurrent games or the memory footprint limits for loading external AI plugins or game definitions. - The system shall support loading at least 50 unique game definitions and 10 external AI plugins without exceeding 256MB of heap memory.
